claims.claim_text: Aircraft Controls' military OEM programs are anchored on the F-35 program, which is a material revenue driver; timing of orders/material receipts on F-35 caused a $29M sales decrease in FY2022.
claims.subject: Moog Inc. Aircraft Controls segment
claims.predicate: is a supplier of flight-control components on
claims.object_value: F-35 program (Lockheed Martin Joint Strike Fighter)
claims.source_quote: The timing of orders and delayed material receipts on the F-35 program decreased sales $29 million, lower volumes for foreign military programs decreased sales $19 million...

claims.claim_text: Military aftermarket revenue depends on F-18 program orders; lower F-18 orders were a headwind in FY2022.
claims.subject: Moog Aircraft Controls military aftermarket
claims.source_quote: Lower orders for the F-18 program and supply chain constraints affecting other legacy aircraft programs was mostly offset by higher spares and repair activity on the V-22 and the F-15 programs.

claims.subject: Moog Aircraft Controls military aftermarket
